t: A coin-sized RISC-V Linux board for tiny Wi-Fi cameras.
steps: Find the board on Taobao or AliExpress, ideally as a kit with the camera and serial module.
Read the AvaotaF1 GitHub page for the pinout and boot notes.
Wire a USB serial adapter to the header and open a serial terminal on your computer.
Install the open xfel tool and hold the FEL button to enter flashing mode.
Flash the RustSBI boot package from the Firmware folder and watch it start on the console.
Set up the Tina Linux 5.0 SDK on a Linux computer and build a system image.
Connect the GC2083 camera and capture a first test picture.
